origin: copied from the accepted Workbench mockup, sentence table S, 2026-10-13

data.SEL_NONE: No cells selected. Drag a lasso, click a point, click a colour in the legend, or gate a feature.
data.MARK_NEEDS_SEL: Select cells first, then mark them.
data.TOTALS: All cells: good {g} · review {r} · bad {b} · unassigned {u}
data.LASSO_VIOLIN: The lasso works on maps and scatters. On a violin, click a group to select it.
data.UMAP_EMPTY: No UMAP yet.|Press Compute UMAP on the Map tab. It takes about 45 s for 3,000 cells.
data.TSNE_EMPTY: No t-SNE yet.|Press Compute t-SNE on the Map tab. It takes about 20 s for 3,000 cells.
data.MAP_BUSY_EMPTY: Computing {map}…|The plot fills in when it is done. You can keep marking cells meanwhile.
data.STOPPED: {map} stopped. The last map is kept.
data.PCA_DONE: PCA on {f} features: PC1 and PC2 explain {v}% of the variation.
data.PCA_STALE: The feature list or scaling changed. Press Compute PCA to update the map.
data.MAPS_OLD: The UMAP and t-SNE were made from the previous PCA. Compute them again to match.
data.PCA_TOO_FEW: Tick at least two features to compute a PCA.
data.BUSY_ONE: Wait for {map} to finish, or press Stop.
data.CLUSTER_DONE: {k} groups from {method}, seed {seed}. The same seed gives the same groups.
data.CLUSTER_DONE_HDB: {k} groups and {noise} unassigned cells from HDBSCAN.
data.CLUSTER_NEEDS_UMAP: Compute a UMAP first, or group from PCA or the features.
data.SEED_OFF: HDBSCAN has no random start, so it needs no seed.
data.NO_GROUPS: Press Cluster on the Groups tab to colour by group.
data.FEAT_COUNT: {k} of {n} features used for the maps
data.BELL_NO: Not bell-shaped: skew {s}, tail weight {k}. Auto rescale picks {x}.
data.SHAPIRO: Shapiro–Wilk p = {p}. With thousands of cells this test says “not normal” for almost any feature, so the Bell column uses skew and tail weight instead.
data.SYNC_ON: The viewer uses the plot’s colours.
data.SYNC_OFF: The viewer keeps napari’s own label colours.
